notes: Tracker deviation: a new AR/AW handshake at the same edge as the owner's completing handshake is also captured (spec (b) allows it), so the tracker doesn't lose that request. AR has priority if both handshake (CHK-014(a) flags that). W data/strobe and APB data are stored per-beat (256 entries) so the compare happens once both the k-th APB completion and k-th W handshake have occurred, in either order. Wrap address uses '/' and '%' on 32-bit values (T is non-zero). Not compiled or simulated here.
